auditType: offline --audit-data-campus-only execution plus static geometry review

execution.measuredSolidTerrainEdge: Approximately x1326 for z -570..-277; approximately x1230 at z -600

findings.finding: Hole 1's tee at (1290,-540) is valid, but its basket at (1348,-545) is beyond the immutable snapshot's solid terrain. The proposed x1278..1490 course extends far past the measured edge near x1326.
findings.requiredFix: Re-site the entire course to fully surveyed land or create and hash a legitimately expanded immutable snapshot before modeling.

findings.finding: Each completed hall reports two stair/lift cores, but both cores are solid polished-andesite boxes. There is no clear shaft, stair geometry, landing, or level door between the two floors.
findings.requiredFix: Build and verify contained no-jump stairs and lift analogues at both remote cores; route-test both floors and both exits.

findings.finding: The twelve Meta halls use 22-by-12 footprints. Each reported rack row is only about three blocks long. These are compact markers, not credible fully detailed walk-through data buildings.
findings.requiredFix: Enlarge or redesign the Meta hall program so entrance, long aisle, rack fields, transverse paths, utility gallery, tool/store, staff nook, and rear exit all exist as enterable final-state spaces.

findings.finding: Support venues start as hollow shells, then their two named program halves are emitted as solid glass and concrete volumes occupying most of the interior. They are not enterable NOC/operations, office, kitchen, or staff rooms.
findings.requiredFix: Model room shells, doors, clear floor/head volume, circulation and actual furnishings. Prove every named room identity from the final state.

findings.finding: Hall and support terrain is sampled on a four-block grid plus edges, while only sampled low points receive piers. unsupportedFoundationColumns is then hardcoded to zero without a full-column support or neighbor-fluid proof.
findings.requiredFix: Census every footprint/support column and relevant fluid/gravity halo; measure unsupported columns from final geometry and abort unless zero.

findings.finding: The modeled pond is a regular ellipse despite the binding requirement for an irregular drainage-informed shoreline with at least three concave bays. It has a sealed bed but no proven side containment or exact source-fluid disposition ledger.
findings.requiredFix: Use the binding shoreline schedule, preserve/record source water, add reviewed containment and stage water safely, then verify the post-state shoreline.

findings.finding: The route returns over the same west approach nodes, making an out-and-back lollipop rather than a continuous district loop. Two controlled road crossings are reported but not modeled or measured.
findings.requiredFix: Provide a distinct return leg and explicit crossing objects; measure length, grades, clear width, headroom, freight separation and bidirectional route success.

findings.finding: The course is nine paired parallel rows. Only tee and basket endpoints are surveyed. Flight corridors, landing zones and basket-to-next-tee routes are not scanned against paths, roads, buildings, utilities, shelters or water; safeFlightCorridors=18 and conflicts=0 are hardcoded.
findings.requiredFix: Generate 18 genuinely distinct routed holes and machine-test every buffered flight, landing and next-tee path against all protected geometries.

findings.finding: The implementation provides four overview cameras, not the required tee and reverse-basket pair for every hole.
findings.requiredFix: Emit at least 36 hole-linked first-pass cameras plus matching second-pass records, then add course overview cameras.

findings.finding: Worker commons and disc golf are returned by the model but have no dedicated coverage or acceptance predicates in the package report. The top-level READY_FOR_PREFLIGHT rule still depends only on protected block entities.
findings.requiredFix: Add measured commons/course/terrain/route/evidence gates and make report readiness require every acceptance predicate plus zero unapproved cross-scope overrides.

findings.finding: The 20 campus halls, support buildings, commons, landscape groups and course objects are not included in the package's global publication object registry.
findings.requiredFix: Emit stable object IDs, exact bounds/routes, camera IDs and first/second-pass manifest entries for every release object before database import.
